verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a billing platform like Paddle, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a Paddle-branded command-line tool. The AI-native tooling shown is a hosted MCP server, a docs MCP server, agent skills, SDKs, an OpenAPI spec and a Postman collection. The plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI run inside third-party agent CLIs, so they do not count as a Paddle CLI.
